jobs.stylePrompt: Render as a Japanese manga color illustration whose drawing is visibly made with a flexible pen. Make the focal contours angular, taut, and strongly pressure-varied: sharp cheek and jaw turns, narrow almond eyes, articulated fingers, and long wedge-shaped hair locks when people appear. Preserve adult age and the specified expression, but simplify the face into a drawn manga construction rather than a realistic portrait. Keep assertive black linework visible through translucent local-color washes. Use short parallel hatching along form, a few hooked exploratory lines, white paper gaps, and concentrated dark accents at overlapping hair and cloth folds. Model the body and existing objects with drawn planes instead of smooth painterly volume. Keep background architecture economical and less detailed than the figure. Show energy through line pressure even in a still scene. Avoid photographic skin, uniformly thin polished outlines, soft all-over airbrush shading, unrelated action or props, and decorative collage. Follow the separate subject-and-scene description for people, clothing, objects, and setting; do not add them from this style instruction. Do not render text, logos, speech balloons, panel borders, or watermarks.
jobs.scenePrompt: Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. A young adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair blowing gently to the left and expressive brown eyes wears a rust-red hooded coat and a black backpack. She holds an unfolded paper map in both hands at chest level, with the entire map visible near the lower edge. Frame her from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: her head, torso, and map should fill most of the left half of the image. Her body is turned three-quarters to the right, and she looks up toward the right with a curious, slightly uncertain expression. She stands on a sunlit outdoor commuter-train platform. A long white commuter train with a muted teal stripe remains clearly visible across the right half of the background. The platform canopy and columns recede diagonally from the upper left; a few indistinct commuters stand far behind her. Keep the woman, map, platform, and train all clearly visible.

jobs.stylePrompt: Render as a softly colored Japanese manga illustration with unmistakably rounded, simplified character construction. When people appear, draw broad oval manga eyes with substantial dark upper lashes and small ordinary catchlights, softly full cheeks, a tiny nose indicated by one short mark, a small mouth, and a gently rounded chin. Retain adult age, the supplied expression, and clothing. Use clean fine curved ink outlines and simplified round-ended hair clumps. Place pale matte local colors in broad mostly flat regions; use only a few light cool gray-violet shadow shapes beneath the hair and at clothing overlaps. Leave the face largely unshaded, with no realistic skin texture or sculptural portrait modeling. Draw the background with spare straight lines and large quiet color planes so the rounded face is the main visual signal. Keep the scene and physical objects intact. Avoid chibi bodies, glossy painting, dense hatching, dramatic black shadows, monsters, damage, and unrequested costumes. Follow the separate subject-and-scene description for people, clothing, objects, and setting; do not add them from this style instruction. Do not render text, logos, speech balloons, panel borders, or watermarks.

jobs.stylePrompt: Render as a crisp contemporary Japanese manga color illustration with precise graphic facial construction and concentrated jewel-like color. When people appear, draw large almond-shaped manga eyes with thick sharply tapered upper lash contours, clear multilayer iris rings, and two ordinary geometric light reflections; use a tiny nose and small precise mouth, retaining adult age and the specified expression. Draw hair as clean tapered ribbon groups, separated by sharply controlled fine ink lines and narrow cool-violet reflected highlights without changing its base color. Use saturated local colors for the supplied focal materials, crisp cel-shadow shapes, selective transparent color layering, and restrained pink reflected light on cheeks. Keep skin mostly matte and simplified rather than realistically modeled. Make eyes and selected hair reflections luminous, with quiet low-saturation background planes and sharply readable silhouettes. Avoid star-shaped pupils, emblem-like eye marks, floating glitter, unrequested costumes or hair colors, painterly line loss, and gloss over every surface. Follow the separate subject-and-scene description for people, clothing, objects, and setting; do not add them from this style instruction. Do not render text, logos, speech balloons, panel borders, or watermarks.
